name: wmkf_appreviewanswer-question-options
_comment: Additive point-in-time snapshot of the complete option list presented for categorical review questions. This makes each submitted review self-contained for exact later rendering even after the live question set changes.

attributes.description: Canonical ordered JSON array of every {value,label} option presented for picklist and multiselect questions at submission time. Null for richtext and string answers. Independent of the selected answer fields.
